'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[2023 Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
***[[Siege of Gaza City]]
****[[Israel]]i Prime Minister [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] says that "the IDF have completed the [[encirclement]] of [[Gaza City]]". [[Ministry of Defense (Israel)|Defense Minister]] [[Yoav Gallant]] also says that [[Hamas]] has "lost control" of Gaza City as [[Israeli Ground Forces|Israeli troops]] capture the city's municipal buildings. [https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/benjamin-netanyahu/article-772829 (''The Jerusalem Post'')] [https://edition.cnn.com/middleeast/live-news/israel-hamas-war-gaza-news-11-14-23/h_7b0c9f45f2043c83a09a10d553b34cbb (CNN)]
**[[Red Sea crisis]]
***The [[Israel Defense Forces|IDF]] intercepts a [[surface-to-surface missile]] launched from [[Yemen]] over the [[Red Sea]]. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2023/11/14/Israeli-says-intercepted-missile-in-vicinity-of-Red-Sea (Al Arabiya)]
**Seven [[Palestinians]] are killed in an [[Israel]]i raid in [[Tulkarm]] in the occupied [[West Bank]]. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2023/11/14/Five-Palestinians-killed-in-West-Bank-clashes-with-Israeli-army-Hospital- (Al Arabiya)]
*[[2024 Iran–Israel conflict]], [[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**Two civilians killed by Israeli missile strikes and shelling in [[Netu'a]], [[southern Lebanon]] and a team of journalists were struck in [[Yaroun]], with no casualties.[https://www.terrorism-info.org.il/en/operation-iron-swords-updated-to-1-p-m-november-14-2023/ (TerrorismInfo)] 
*[[Mali War]]
**The [[Malian Armed Forces]] recapture the town of [[Kidal]] from [[Tuareg people|Tuareg]] separatist forces, according to [[military junta|junta]] leader [[Assimi Goïta]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/africa/20231114-mali-junta-seizes-strategic-northern-stronghold-of-kidal (AFP via France 24)]
*[[Myanmar civil war (2021–present)|Myanmar civil war]]
**[[Operation 1027]]
***The [[Chin National Army]] says that it has successfully captured the [[border town]] of [[Rikhawdar]] in [[Chin State]]. [https://www.irrawaddy.com/news/war-against-the-junta/chin-resistance-seizes-indian-border-town-from-myanmar-junta.html (''The Irrawaddy'')]
***[[India]] deports 39 [[Myanmar Army]] soldiers who abandoned their positions and fled across [[India–Myanmar border|the border]] into [[Mizoram]]. The soldiers were disarmed by the [[Assam Rifles]] before being sent back to [[Myanmar]] by helicopter. [https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/39-myanmar-soldiers-who-entered-mizoram-sent-back/article67532430.ece (''The Hindu'')]
**[[Operation 1107]]
***Heavy fighting is reported in [[Loikaw]], the capital of [[Kayah State]], as [[Karenni people|Karenni]] rebel groups attempt to capture the city from the [[Tatmadaw|military]]. [https://www.irrawaddy.com/news/burma/tens-of-thousands-trapped-as-myanmar-resistance-strikes-kayah-state-capital.html (''The Irrawaddy'')]
**The [[Arakan Army]] claims that nearly 40 positions in [[Rakhine State]] have been abandoned by the military. [https://www.irrawaddy.com/news/burma/almost-40-myanmar-junta-positions-abandoned-in-rakhine-arakan-army.html (''The Irrawaddy'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Six people are killed and eighteen others are injured in a crash between a semi-trailer and a charter bus on [[Interstate 70]] in [[Licking County, Ohio|Licking County]], [[Ohio]], [[United States]]. [https://www.dispatch.com/story/news/local/2023/11/14/mass-casualty-incident-closes-i-70-near-ohio-310-in-licking-county-semi-crash-kirkersville-ohio/71578089007/ (''The Columbus Dispatch'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[Ethiopia–United States relations]]
**[[USAID]] announces the resumption of [[Food aid dependency in Ethiopia|food aid]] distribution to [[Ethiopia]] following an agreement with the [[Government of Ethiopia|Ethiopian government]] on enhanced [[Aid effectiveness|monitoring measures]]. USAID suspended aid delivery in June due to allegations of diversion. [https://tribune.net.ph/2023/11/us-says-to-resume-food-aid-across-ethiopia-after-monitoring-agreement/ (AFP via ''Daily Tribune'')]
*[[Belize]] suspends diplomatic relations with Israel over its war conduct, and calls for an immediate ceasefire. [https://www.cnn.com/2023/11/14/world/belize-suspends-diplomatic-ties-israel-ceasefire/index.html (CNN)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Israel–Hamas war protests]]
**[[March for Israel]]
***Tens of thousands of demonstrators gather on the [[National Mall]] in [[Washington, D.C.]] to condemn the [[Antisemitism during the 2023 Israel–Hamas war|rise in antisemitism]] during the war and call for the release of [[Hamas]]-held [[2023 Israel–Hamas war hostage crisis|hostages]]. [https://apnews.com/article/israel-palestinian-war-march-washington-830cb77476af80ffde431165ee01533d (AP News)]
*[[Human trafficking in Myanmar]]
**[[Myanmar]] authorities rescue 19 [[South Koreans]] from captivity by an unspecified illegal entity in [[Tachileik]], [[Shan State]]. [https://www.scmp.com/news/asia/east-asia/article/3241528/19-south-koreans-held-captive-myanmar-rescued-says-seoul (AFP via ''SCMP'')]
*The [[Federal Supreme Court of Iraq]] dismisses [[List of speakers of the Council of Representatives of Iraq|Parliament Speaker]] [[Mohamed al-Halbousi]] and Representative Laith al-Duleimi, following a complaint alleging that Halbousi [[Forgery|falsified]] a [[resignation letter]] that would have removed Duleimi from [[Council of Representatives of Iraq|parliament]]. [https://www.barrons.com/news/iraq-supreme-court-says-dismissed-powerful-parliament-speaker-863f031b (AFP via ''Barron's'')]
*[[Interpol]] announces its first successful identification for [[Operation Identify Me]]. A murder victim found in a river in [[Antwerp, Belgium]] in 1992 is identified as a woman from [[Cardiff]], [[Wales]], [[United Kingdom]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-67407020 (BBC News)]
*The [[South Yorkshire Police]] in the UK announces that a man has been arrested for  [[manslaughter]] in connection with the death of [[ice hockey]] player [[Adam Johnson (ice hockey)|Adam Johnson]] during a match between the [[Nottingham Panthers]] and [[Sheffield Steelers]] on October 28. [https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2023/nov/14/adam-johnson-police-arrest-man-over-death-of-ice-hockey-player-sheffield (''The Guardian'')]
